interpretation.phase_costs: Exact differences of existing Program consumption marks, inclusive of logging boundary overhead. They are intervals, not intrinsic operation costs.
interpretation.stage1_entry_to_parsed: Includes Pool adapter account/state checks, public decoding and View parsing; cannot isolate pure parse.
interpretation.semantic: Parsed→Semantic interval includes actual semantic work and marker cost.
interpretation.prepare: Semantic→Prepare includes Prepared::new, Accumulator initialization and gamma powers; cannot isolate components.
interpretation.first_merkle: Includes QueryGeometry::for_range for all queries in that transaction plus first Merkle path; later Merkle intervals exclude that setup.
interpretation.checkpoint_read: Parsed→CheckpointRead includes checkpoint decoding/hash checks and gamma powers.
interpretation.pool_overhead: Pool inclusive invoked CU minus nested verifier CU. Includes Pool work, history rollover, CPI invocation and possible Token CPI; existing marks do not split exact pre/post components.
interpretation.measurement_metrics: Per transaction CU is recorded; wall/RSS/swap belong to the encompassing process receipt, not separate per-transaction process measurements.
